extraction.Name: Charles Whipple
extraction.Refused/Protested: Ko, there was nothing said about it.
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: Sold to T. C. Clark for #2500.00, and I was to pay the interest on the mortgage, and I have not yet been able to pay all this.
extraction.NOTES: Patent received from issue station at Parmelee. Did not sign receipt or does not remember signing. Did not make application for patent. Wife and seven children dependent on him for support. Consideration stated as $2100.00 in one reference and $2500.00 in another. Superintendent E. B. McKean. Document dated June 4, 1929.
